brief:
A senior United Nations figure has said she was dismissed from her position for publicly criticizing Israel's conduct in Gaza, according to Al-Monitor. The official stated that her comments on the conflict led to her removal, raising questions about institutional pressure within the UN regarding statements on Israeli policy.

The dismissal reflects existing tensions between UN staff members and leadership over freedom of expression on Middle East issues. International organizations have faced scrutiny over how they handle employee speech on contentious geopolitical matters.
title: UN official says she lost job for criticizing Israel over Gaza
